stats.description:
Configures aircraft stat readouts.

Each entry needs an aircraft, which can be defined by "flid" or "index". FLID is the CID or callsign, and index is the position of the aircraft in the aircraftList, with the first aircraft being 0.

"label" is optional. If no label is provided, the callsign will be used.

proximities.description:
Configures proximity readouts.

Each entry needs at least one aircraft, which can be defined by "flid1" or "index1". FLID is the CID or callsign, and index is the position of the aircraft in the aircraftList, with the first aircraft being 0.

The second point may be either "flid2" or "index2", or an xyPosition or frdPosition relative to the origin.

index.description: Zero-based index of the aircraft in aircraftList.

index1.description: Zero-based index of the first aircraft in aircraftList.

index2.description: Zero-based index of the target aircraft in aircraftList.

xyPosition.description:
xy position relative to the origin.
+x is right
+y is up

frdPosition.description:
Position expressed as a radial and distance from the origin.
r: radial in degrees
d: distance in NM

flid.description:
FLID must be a valid CID or callsign.

	CID: 3 chars beginning with a number
	Callsign: 2-7 chars beginning with a letter

label.description: A label to use for a console entry. 0-16 characters.

playbackSpeed.description:
Playback speed in multiples of real time.
	0: paused
	1: real time
	2: double speed
	etc.

secondsPerUpdate.description:
Frequency at which data blocks update.
	0: continuous
	1: every second
	12: every 12 seconds
	etc.

vRange.description: Scope range from top of screen to bottom of screen in NM.

statsDecimalPlaces.description: Decimal places for stat readouts in the console. Rounding is to the nearest decimal place.

proximityDecimalPlaces.description: Decimal places for proximity readouts in the console. Rounding is to the nearest decimal place.
